description: Apply a *** Begin Patch edit inside the formed direct workspace or an additional filesystem root explicitly granted to this task; success and partial failure carry changed paths and before/after content identities. Update hunks use bare '@@' or '@@ <exact anchor line from file>' — never unified-diff line numbers ('@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@').

patch.description: Patch enclosed in '*** Begin Patch' and '*** End Patch' with '*** Add File: <path>', '*** Update File: <path>' (optional '*** Move to: <path>'), or '*** Delete File: <path>' sections. Start each update hunk with bare '@@' or '@@ <exact anchor line>' followed by ' ' context, '-' removed, and '+' added lines; do not use unified-diff line numbers like '@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@'.
